stem.text: Pentaerythritol is used as an intermediate in the manufacture of paint.

stem.alt: Structural formula of pentaerythritol, labelled pentaerythritol: a central carbon atom bonded by diagonal bonds to four groups, HOCH2 at upper left, CH2OH at upper right, HOCH2 at lower left and CH2OH at lower right.

A.text: Pentaerythritol can be dehydrated by concentrated sulfuric acid to form an alkene.

B.text: The empirical formula and molecular formula of pentaerythritol are different.

C.text: Pentaerythritol does not react with acidified potassium manganate(VII).

D.text: One mole of pentaerythritol gives two moles of hydrogen gas on reaction with an excess of sodium.
